summary: Phase 4 testing completed successfully. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified Q&A section, Sentiment Analysis, and CSV Export functionality. All features working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 4 - Q&A Function correctly implemented:
- POST /api/news/posts/{id}/questions creates question with question_id, text, upvotes array, upvote_count ✓
- GET /api/news/posts/{id}/questions returns questions sorted by upvote_count descending ✓
- POST /api/news/questions/{qid}/upvote toggles upvote (adds/removes user_id from upvotes array) ✓
- POST /api/news/questions/{qid}/answer adds editor answer (only admin/redakteur can answer) ✓
- DELETE /api/news/questions/{qid} deletes question (owner or editor) ✓
Phase 4 - Multilingual News correctly implemented:
- PUT /api/news/posts/{id}/translations stores translations for de, en, fr, es, tr ✓
- GET /api/news/posts/{id}/localized?lang=en returns English translated content ✓
- GET /api/news/posts/{id}/localized?lang=de returns German translated content ✓
- Unsupported language falls back to original content ✓
Phase 4 - Sentiment Analysis correctly implemented:
- POST /api/news/analyze-sentiment analyzes texts using GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations ✓
- Returns sentiment (positive/neutral/negative), score (0.0-1.0), keywords ✓
- GET /api/news/posts/{id}/sentiment analyzes post comments and returns summary ✓
- Falls back to neutral if LLM key has no balance ✓
Phase 4 - Export Functions correctly implemented:
- GET /api/surveys/{id}/export returns CSV with survey responses (Teilnehmer, Zeitpunkt, answers) ✓
- GET /api/feedback/export returns CSV with all feedback entries (ID, Kategorie, Betreff, etc.) ✓
- GET /api/news/posts/{id}/reads/export returns CSV with read receipts (Benutzer, Gelesen am) ✓
- All exports use StreamingResponse with proper Content-Disposition headers ✓
Frontend correctly implemented:
- News detail shows Q&A section (data-testid='qa-section') with question input ✓
- Q&A shows upvote buttons, answer links for editors ✓
- News detail shows Sentiment section (data-testid='sentiment-section') for editors ✓
- Sentiment shows Positiv/Neutral/Negativ counts with visual bar ✓
- Surveys page has CSV export links on survey cards ✓
- Feedback tab has CSV Export link ✓
